## Problem
Finance teams rely on consistent numbers between the dashboard and exported files, but discrepancies between them undermine trust in the data. This leads to delays in reporting and uncertainty over which figures are accurate.

## Who is affected
- Finance teams at customer companies are directly questioning the data and experiencing reporting delays [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].
- Account managers and support teams are fielding questions and troubleshooting the mismatch, as indicated by the 9 support mentions and 3 account management mentions [i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc].
- Users attempting to export data are encountering technical errors, as shown by 3 session logs reporting error exceptions [i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:605237c4f13ef789].

## Evidence
The issue has been reported by 7 accounts, representing a total ARR of £7,050,000 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. There have been 16 total mentions of the problem across 4 different routes: 9 from support, 3 from account management, 3 from sessions, and 1 from sales [i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:69ced11dd0bfa22c][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b].

Customers report that finance teams are comparing dashboard totals with exported CSV files and finding them off, which causes confusion and distrust in the numbers used for monthly reporting [i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:79dbb87fe13aebb4]. One customer from Tidewell Marine & Cargo stated, Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard [i:2e7168b298e234f6]. Another from Marrowgate Commercial noted the mismatch is consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d]. The problem leads to operational delays, as one insight notes the export figures mismatch is causing delays in our month-end close [i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].

## Why now
Three of the affected accounts, representing a combined ARR of £2,390,000, have renewals due within the next 90 days as of 2026-10-01 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. Stannary Commercial (ARR £540,000) renews on 2026-12-05, Ashcombe Property Mutual (ARR £250,000) on 2026-11-30, and Marrowgate Commercial (ARR £1,600,000) on 2026-12-12 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d]. The volume of recent reports is significant, with 10 of the 16 total mentions occurring in September and October 2026 [i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. This concentration of feedback coincides with the critical month-end and quarter-end financial reporting cycles, where data accuracy is paramount.
